t: A high power combi drill and impact driver twin kit complete with 2 x 18V 5.0Ah LXT batteries and a rapid charger. Combi drill features a variable speed control trigger, 2-speed selection, 21 torque settings plus drill mode and a built-in battery fuel gauge. Ideal for most drilling applications whilst 91Nm of hard torque provides for jobs that require extra power. Impact driver has a huge 165Nm of torque, variable speed trigger for extra control of the delivery of power and a ¼" hex tool holder. Both tools feature metal gearboxes for added durability and twin LED job lights for working in dark areas. Makita XPT system (Extreme Protection Technology) protects against water and dust ingress when used in harsh weather conditions. 5.0Ah Li-ion batteries provide long run times between charge cycles, and can be part charged without damaging the cell. Rapid charger can fully charge each battery from flat in 46 minutes.
